claim: In the matching retail DLL, static Menu_SoundManager.Change_BGM_Theme (0x06005296) has exact signature blob 0003011187480202, parameters (ThemeMusicID index, Boolean bAsync, Boolean bStart), and an exact 399-byte body. It compares signed index against ThemeMusicInfoManager.inst.themeMusicList.Count and writes index=0 when index is not below Count. It loads GetThemeMusicInfo(index), calls CheckValidationDLC, and replaces the local with GetThemeMusicInfo(0) when validation is false. When bAsync is true it writes g_ProgressBGM_Continue=false, g_KeepBgmNumber=15 and MyMusic_SelectFile_Admission=String.Empty, then chooses IsDLC: true starts CoChange_BGMandPlay_FromAssetBundle with path prefix "dlc_assets/theme_music/", raw 33 and bStart; false starts CoChange_BGMandPlay with path prefix "Sound/Bgm/", raw 33 and bStart. When bAsync is false it chooses IsDLC: true attempts AssetBundle.LoadFromFile on the DLC path, loads the named asset and writes audioClipInfo[33] when the bundle exists, otherwise falls back to GetThemeMusicInfo(0) and Resources.Load from "Sound/Bgm/"; non-DLC directly Resources.Loads the same resource prefix. The synchronous paths write audioClipInfo[33] through AudioClipInfo.Set, then write g_ProgressBGM_Continue=false, g_KeepBgmNumber=15 and MyMusic_SelectFile_Admission=String.Empty. FACT-0108 pins the three already-canonical direct caller sites at IL+0x003E, 0x00B8 and 0x00EE.
